$comment: The one list of MediaMake's guard rails, read by tools/guard-rails.mjs (the pre-edit guard in
On a protected branch, every file git would track is a framework file: Claude may not edit it
or commit there, and the guard says where the change belongs. Your own work is what git ignores
(projects/, out/, brands/, thumbnails/jobs/, overlays/), so it is never blocked.
areas: the first one whose paths match a file gives its hint. A path ending in / is a folder,
* matches inside one folder and ** across folders. allow: committed files that may still change
on a protected branch. When a folder moves (apps/lyrics_videos to apps/studio), change it here.

areas.name: generated file
areas.where: It is generated, never edited by hand: SKILLS.md and skills.json come from `node tools/skills.mjs index`, presets.json from `npm run sync-presets -w lyrics_videos`. Regenerate it on the branch of the change that needs it.

areas.name: lockfile
areas.where: The lockfile changes only in a PR that changes dependencies. To install on main, use `npm ci`, which leaves it as it is.

areas.name: skill file
areas.where: Skills are shared by everyone who pulls. Feedback for this production goes in its own projects/<slug>/prefs.md (git ignores it). A general lesson or fix for the skill, or a variant from fork-skill, goes on a branch and a PR.

areas.name: production graphic or catalog entry
areas.where: Anything made for one production belongs in its own folder, apps/lyrics_videos/projects/<slug>/, which git ignores. Only a graphic or entry every production should get goes into the engine, on a branch and a PR.

areas.name: video engine file
areas.where: The user's work in apps/lyrics_videos (projects/, out/, brands/, thumbnails/jobs/, overlays/) is ignored by git and can change on any branch. A change to the engine, its scripts or the sample project goes on a branch and a PR; when one production needs it, say which in the PR.

areas.name: MediaMake app file
areas.where: App changes go on a branch and a PR (feat/… or fix/…).

areas.name: package or MCP server file
areas.where: Packages and MCP servers are released from main, so a change goes on a branch and a PR.

areas.name: repo setup file
areas.where: Repo setup, CI and rules for every session go on a branch and a PR.

default.name: framework file
default.where: Every file git tracks is shared by everyone who pulls, so a change to it goes on a branch and a PR.
